p1_03.roleKeyImmutabilityContract: Canonical role_key cannot change after creation; display metadata remains mutable
p1_03.roleKeyDbEnforcement: PostgreSQL and D1 triggers reject normal role_key updates
p1_03.keyMutationTests: PASS on D1 and disposable PostgreSQL
